name: Meme Chaos
description: Random meme events while you play: roasts on death, fake system dialogs, notifications, captcha, news ticker, full-screen gags and more. No faces, visual only, never changes gameplay.

roast.name: Roasts
roast.description: Show a funny message when you die and when you win.

sounds.name: Meme sounds
sounds.description: Play pitch-shifted sounds on death, win and chaos events.

chaos.name: Chaos events
chaos.description: Random visual gags while you play: screen flashes, flying words, rainbow player.

mirror.name: Mirror and upside-down events
mirror.description: Sometimes the picture is mirrored or flipped for 3 seconds (visual only).
